original: かつてはあんなに輝いてたのに、老いらくの恋で若い愛人にガッポリ持ってかれるなんて、彼も晩節を汚したもんだな。

en.text: He used to shine so brightly, but to be taken advantage of by a young lover in his old age—he really has sullied his later years.

original: いつか恋に落ちるでしょう。

en.text: One day, I'll fall in love.
